resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Danish source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review checks, typecheck, complete build, route and generated-link checks, and the full test suite passed after the cycle was finalized.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Danish pass identified ten terminology, clarity, formula, and untranslated-text defects; all ten were corrected.

findings.summary: The Ohm-law worked-example title used aktuelle, which means current or topical, instead of strømmen.
evidence: The previous title was Find aktuelle.

findings.summary: The electrical-power heading translated power as strøm, meaning current.
evidence: The previous title was Elektrisk strøm while the section describes electrical power.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff current-law heading used nuværende, a literal current/present adjective, instead of the electrical term strømlov.
evidence: The previous title was Kirchhoffs nuværende lov.

findings.summary: The current-law example used aktuelle retninger and awkward repeated branch-flow wording.
evidence: The previous paragraph used aktuelle retninger instead of strømretninger and bære en kombineret 5 A væk.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the example with natural Danish current-flow terminology.

findings.summary: The voltage-law paragraph used ungrammatical singular wording for voltage rises and falls and an awkward loop-direction term.
evidence: The previous paragraph began Den algebraiske sum af spændingen stiger og falder and used løkkeretning.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with natural Danish circuit terminology.

findings.summary: The cosine formula retained the English hypotenuse label.
evidence: The previous expression was cos(θ) = tilstødende / hypotenuse.

findings.summary: The inverse-cosine formula retained the English hypotenuse label.
evidence: The previous expression was θ = cos^-1(tilstødende / hypotenuse).

findings.summary: A practical unit-check bullet remained in English.
evidence: The previous bullet was Convert before multiplying or dividing.

findings.summary: A second practical unit-check bullet remained in English.
evidence: The previous bullet was Round only at the end so intermediate results retain useful precision.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge bullet retained an English sentence fragment about sizes above gauge 0.
evidence: The previous bullet ended with sizes above gauge 0 use 00, 000, or 0000.
